exposure: Small for Gestational Age (SGA) status (term vs. preterm)
cohort: 100 Small for Gestational Age (SGA) neonates, identified using Lubchenco growth charts, were enrolled in a tertiary care hospital NICU.
finding: The incidence of hypoglycemia was 26%, with a significantly higher prevalence in preterm SGA neonates (61.54%) compared to term SGA neonates (38.46%).
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with an increased risk of hypoglycemia.
